name: Classic Bingo
tagline: A wise owl and a spinning cage, for any day of the year.
ogImageAlt: Classic Bingo: a bingo board with pink numbered balls, an owl and a spinning bingo cage

description.board: A classic bingo board for the classroom, for any time of year: draw the numbers 1 to 99 with cheerful sounds and animations, then play English challenges for kids aged 7 to 10.
description.cards: Printable Classic Bingo cards: 24 unique tombola cards on A4 sheets, ready to print and cut for the classroom.
description.answers: The answers to every Classic Bingo English challenge, for the host.
